question: What mental state brings liberation to a person in this very life?
premises: A person may possess the transcendent mind-state called unmanas
This state transcends ordinary mental activity
Liberation is attributed to such a person
inference: Therefore, one whose mind has become unmanas attains liberation here.
uncertainties: bhavantīha shows number agreement tension with singular mokṣo
plain_english: For one whose mind has become the transcendent Unmana, liberation arises here.
